purpose: Represent user intentions, purposes, aspirations, dreams, and concrete requests as auditable mission contracts without inventing hidden goals.
principles: Explicit user intent outranks inferred convenience.
Inference may clarify means but must not silently alter sovereign goals.
Long-horizon aspirations are decomposed into reversible milestones and the next highest safe action.
Unknowns that materially change the outcome remain explicit until resolved.
Every action must trace to an intent, acceptance criterion, dependency, risk control, or recovery need.
A dream or aspiration is not declared achieved until its defined observable outcome is actually evidenced.
